title: Matrix stiffness transcriptomic responses and osteoporosis: reproducible meta-analysis
description: Code, dated protocols, systematic-search records and derived results for a study-clustered transcriptomic meta-analysis of matrix stiffness responses and their relationship to human osteoblast-lineage programs and osteoporosis cohorts. The analyses define the limits of cross-study and cross-cohort transfer and do not constitute a diagnostic test.
